headline: Power sector stocks decline following PM-DHARA scheme announcement
hook: Power stocks dip despite massive infrastructure boost
summary: The Indian government has unveiled the PM-DHARA scheme, a ₹1.86 lakh crore initiative designed to upgrade power transmission infrastructure. The project aims to integrate 135 GW of renewable energy into the national grid. Despite the long-term growth potential of this investment, major power stocks including Tata Power, Adani Power, NTPC, and Power Grid saw declines in Thursday's trading session.
why_it_matters: Short-term market volatility may mask long-term infrastructure growth potential.
winners_losers: Infrastructure firms gain / short-term traders hurt

headline: Bernstein initiates coverage on Tata Power, Waaree Energies, and Premier Energies
hook: Bernstein rates the top solar stocks
summary: Brokerage firm Bernstein has initiated coverage on major Indian solar stocks, picking its preferred winner among Tata Power, Waaree Energies, and Premier Energies. The report evaluates the growth prospects, manufacturing capabilities, and market positioning of these renewable energy players. Indian retail investors tracking the green energy transition and solar manufacturing sector can use these insights to assess portfolio allocations.
why_it_matters: Brokerage ratings could shift institutional flows in solar stocks.
